Overview

Akureyri is a city in Northeast with a population of 19,000. Iceland’s northern capital and cultural hub, nestled at the head of Eyjafjörður with stunning Arctic scenery. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 120 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
